# KAISTEEL

> KAISTEEL creates the Movable Outdoor Social Kitchen. KAISTEEL LIMITED, Hong Kong, is the brand, B2B sales and contracting entity. KAISTEEL collaborates with independent manufacturing partners in mainland China, integrating flexible manufacturing capabilities under a unified product design approach while coordinating production and quality-control requirements. Products are manufactured according to project-specific technical specifications and KAISTEEL's established quality-control requirements. Final product configurations are reviewed and approved before production begins. Products ship from China; no overseas inventory or warehouses.

## Manufacturing information
- Relevant partner details may be provided only during due diligence according to the actual order, disclosure authorization and confidentiality requirements; disclosure is not automatic.

## Products
- PRO has a fixed standard width of 2300 mm; MAX has a fixed standard width of 2900 mm. All other widths are named CUSTOM followed by the width in millimetres, for example CUSTOM 3500, and quoted per project. Other sizes available as CUSTOM. MAX does not mean the largest available size. Keep the same model name and width across the quotation, PI and drawings. Other dimensions and powered opening and closing arrangements follow the approved configuration.
- System Shell: main structure, interior and exterior finishes, powered lifting/opening mechanisms, lighting and control systems. Excludes internal cabinetry, worktops, equipment and appliances.
- Appliance-Ready: System Shell plus internal cabinetry, doors, worktops, sink, faucet and shelving, with interfaces reserved for specified appliance models. Appliances are not automatically included.
- Full Package: Appliance-Ready plus agreed internal appliances and equipment. Exact models, factory integration and destination applicability require approved BOM and PI.
- Materials, dimensions, quantities, packing and lead times follow approved BOM, drawings and PI. Appliance certificates do not certify the whole system. Qualified local professionals handle site assembly and utility connections.

## Commercial and delivery
- EXW (Incoterms 2020), named place in the quotation. Other terms including FOB/CIF/DDP require feasible logistics and KAISTEEL written approval per order. DDP is not offered for Australia. Freight, insurance, customs, duties, taxes, importer responsibilities and final-mile delivery are allocated in the approved quotation/PI/contract. Unloading, installation, utility connections and site work are not automatically included.
- Payment amounts, proportions and milestones are order-specific in the KAISTEEL-approved quotation/PI/contract. Deposit must actually be received before scheduling; final configuration approval precedes production. Deduct eligible sample credit from the pre-shipment balance; pay the remaining balance in full before shipment. Written quotation and applicable terms govern validity.
- Container quantity requires confirmed configuration, measured packing data and the approved packing plan; no guaranteed loading quantity or 30-day delivery.

## Sample credit
- Sample PIs and equipment credit are available to registered companies worldwide, without model, equipment-value or intended-use restrictions. The sample-order window is 1 September–31 December 2026, based on actual deposit receipt. A brand or group may receive credit only once globally. Credit represents one equipment unit, averaged for multi-unit first orders, and is limited to the payable pre-shipment balance with no cash value, refund or carry-over. Qualifying orders are one or more full 40HQ containers for one customer (one paying entity); multi-customer consolidation is ineligible. A first-order full 40HQ can use credit against its own pre-shipment balance without POD or a 180-day wait. Otherwise, the subsequent qualifying deposit must actually arrive by Day 180 at 23:59 local time at the sample PI final receiving location; Day 1 is the day after carrier-POD delivery there. Equipment-only credit excludes other charges. Takes effect on 11 November 2026, 00:00 HKT (UTC+8).
- Identify the first order by the applicant’s first contract and first payment. A full-40HQ first-order credit is first-container equipment value divided by equipment-unit count. No port-arrival substitute or deemed-arrival rule applies.
- Excluded: sample or LCL surcharges; packaging and packing upgrades; freight, insurance, customs clearance, duties and taxes; custom engineering, upgrades, installation and separately charged services.

## Warranty
- Warranty starts on the shipment date. Up to 15-year limited coverage applies to material/workmanship defects in eligible solid SUS304/SUS316 worktops, 304/316 stainless-steel cabinet bodies/doors and structural steel frames only if included in the ordered specification. Eligible factory-applied powder-coat or supplied decorative-panel finishes have up to 5 years, subject to normal-weathering and corrosion exclusions. The 1-year functional tier covers KAISTEEL-supplied electric actuators, canopy motors, switches, controllers and integrated LED lighting identified in the BOM. Aluminium cabinetry, panels and frames are not automatically in the 15-year tier; cabinet hardware is not automatically in the 1-year tier. Third-party appliances follow their manufacturers’ applicable warranties. The approved BOM and product-specific warranty determine eligibility, conditions and exclusions, subject to applicable law.
- Warranty claims: KAISTEEL Warranty Team, sales@kaisteelkitchen.com.

## Policy commencement
- This policy update takes effect on 11 November 2026, 00:00 HKT (UTC+8). Existing orders remain governed by their agreed documents and applicable statutory rights.
